description: This file defines data models and query parameter classes for US Treasury Auctions, including detailed fields for auction data and query parameters, using Pydantic for data validation.

classes.name: USTreasuryAuctionsQueryParams
classes.description: Class for specifying query parameters for US Treasury Auctions, including filters like security type, CUSIP, date range, and pagination.

classes.name: USTreasuryAuctionsData
classes.description: Class representing detailed data for a US Treasury Auction, including fields like issue date, security type, interest rate, auction details, and various financial metrics.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validator method to set default start and end dates if not provided, defaulting to the last 90 days and today.
